purpose: Classify OLD Project Doctor files and entrypoints by actual retirement dependency after required-check cutover, OLD PR-trigger shutdown, and Status Source writer ownership cutover. This inventory does not infer deletion safety from incomplete code search results.

RETIRE_AFTER_ROLLBACK_WINDOW_CLOSES.reason: These are OLD Doctor operational orchestration/impact/planning/guard/freshness entrypoints. NEW Project Check does not import them, but retained rollback/manual observation surfaces remain until final deletion scope is closed.

STATUS_SOURCE_WRITER_CUTOVER_COMPLETE_RE.reason: The NEW R1 production writer now owns Status Source mutation and the OLD handoff workflow is inactive. These OLD source-lifecycle surfaces are no longer needed for active writer ownership, but are retained until the final exact deletion manifest after Project Status writer cutover and rollback-scope closure.

DEFER_UNTIL_PROJECT_STATUS_WRITER_CUTOVE.reason: NEW R2 Project Status remains read-only and its canonical writer is still disabled. OLD generated Project Status outputs must not be removed until NEW writer ownership and downstream consumer compatibility are proven.

RETAIN_HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE.reason: Frozen migration checkpoints cite OLD contracts and validation artifacts as parity/reference evidence. They are no longer runtime predecessors but remain addressable until an explicit archive policy replaces those references.

PRESERVE_NON_DOCTOR_SHARED_OR_PRESENTATI.reason: Names containing project-doctor are not sufficient evidence of OLD Doctor ownership. Hosted QA belongs to frontend/hosted QA and shared domain validators remain independent Project Check validators.

reasons: Project Status canonical writer ownership has not cut over.

reviews: GitHub code search returned incomplete_results and is not used as negative evidence for consumer absence.

nextStartPoint: Project Status writer ownership cutover: identify the OLD canonical Project Status mutation transport, activate the NEW R2 writer without dual writers, prove downstream compatibility, and freeze before generating the final OLD Doctor deletion manifest.
